title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：sauce　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sauce 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the baker ① poured the sauce that no customer in the bakery would have noted, and he said the pouring was the whole of the week. The ② sauce, meaning the dressing itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; sauce, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ piece of sauce in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ sauce at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Sauce, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the baker said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sauce was the whole of the matter, meaning the flavour and not the dressing. The ⑥ sauce, meaning the flavour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; sauce, he said, is either something you pour or the only word that means both dressing and a flavour. He said the flavour is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ sauce had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ sauce of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of noting; sauce, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sauce I remember is the sauce noted in the bill, which closed in 1964 and is still noted as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Sauce, my mother said in 1966, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all sauce, she said, is a flavour that has agreed to look like dressing. She said the flavour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 酱汁（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 酱汁（指那勺酱汁本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：pour the sauce 浇这一勺酱汁
D. n. 酱汁（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 酱汁之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的酱汁之事）
F. n. 酱汁（指账单里写到、被记下的那一勺）
G. n. 酱汁、滋味（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋味（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: poured the sauce that no customer in the bakery would have noted
The sauce, meaning the dressing itself and not the tray
Every piece of sauce in that bakery
the sauce at the far oven
the sauce was the whole of the matter
the sauce had become a line in a bill
The sauce of the whole thing

answers.why: pour the sauce 意为“浇这一勺酱汁”，1957 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一勺酱汁做了一遍。
sauce 意为“酱汁”，指那勺酱汁本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
sauce 意为“酱汁”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
sauce 意为“酱汁”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sauce 意为“酱汁、滋味”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这勺滋味就是那件事的全部。
sauce 意为“滋味”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那勺酱汁，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sauce 意为“酱汁”，指账单里写到、被记下的那一勺，到 1962 年这一勺成了账单里的一行。
sauce 意为“酱汁之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的酱汁之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记下。
sauce 意为“酱汁”，我记得的是账单里记下过的那一勺，1964 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一勺。
sauce 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，酱汁是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的酱汁。
